items.docs: Authenticates a partner user from a PRM system and returns a short-lived (60 seconds) one-time access token. This is a server-to-server call that does not require a bearer token in the header, instead, the long-lived authentication key is sent in the request body.

info.name: Get URL to Create a New Quote

items.docs: Retrieves a URL that redirects an authenticated partner user to the quote creation page within DealHub for a specific opportunity. This is a client-side call using the one-time access token.

info.name: Get URL to Open an Existing Quote

items.docs: Retrieves a URL that redirects an authenticated partner user to an existing quote within DealHub. This is a client-side call using the one-time access token.

info.name: Get URL to View an Opportunity's Quotes

items.docs: Retrieves a URL that redirects an authenticated partner user to the opportunity details page in DealHub, listing all associated quotes. This is a client-side call using the one-time access token.
